Read a row to the right: the declared field or pinned fact, and every
assignment it decides. Read a column down: the assignment, and every input it rests on." style="text;html=0;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=12;fontColor=#475569;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="1094" width="1100" height="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t236" value="Totality is the in row: no column reads zero, so no assignment is invented by a renderer." style="text;html=0;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=12;fontColor=#475569;fontStyle=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="1144" width="1100" height="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t237" value="A zero in the out column is not a fault here. Those fields reach a Deliverable with no assignment
in between, which is the second drawing; a field that reaches nothing in either is a dead
declaration and fails the build." style="text;html=0;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=11;fontColor=#475569;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="1174" width="1100" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t238" value="Blue rows are declared in Service Intent. Grey rows are the pinned input set of chapter 20,
carried by digest. An override replaces a derived value and carries a reason; it never
replaces an assignment, so it is not a row here." style="text;html=0;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=11;fontColor=#475569;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="1249" width="1100" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

g.text: A mark is one derivation. Read a row to the right: the declared field or pinned fact, and every
assignment it decides. Read a column down: the assignment, and every input it rests on.
Totality is the in row: no column reads zero, so no assignment is invented by a renderer.
A zero in the out column is not a fault here. Those fields reach a Deliverable with no assignment
in between, which is the second drawing; a field that reaches nothing in either is a dead
Blue rows are declared in Service Intent. Grey rows are the pinned input set of chapter 20,
carried by digest. An override replaces a derived value and carries a reason; it never
replaces an assignment, so it is not a row here.
